rationale: Round-2 duty: verify the two fix commits (0d21cb26 code, 0783a507 docs) do not regress my round-1 whole-branch fidelity basis. CONFIRMED — they strengthen it. (1) G1 marker-provenance attestation: reviewed the full materialize.go diff. The attestation key is `mindspec_stage_marker_oid` (bd metadata, written via completeMergeMetadataFn BEFORE each ref publish, refuse-before-publish on write failure); the discriminator now requires attestation==observed-OID on BOTH success legs, with unattested markers cleared as FOREIGN into a full normal run (panel + content gates re-evaluate), and attestation READ failures propagating rather than defaulting either direction. Fidelity assessment: this adds a NEW bd-metadata key, not a `mindspec_phase` write, so the R3.3 writer-inventory/lock obligation is untouched; the fail-closed direction preserves R4's convergence contract (FOREIGN clear ⇒ ordinary run ⇒ same-gate retry semantics unchanged) and hardens the cannot-launder boundary my round-1 audit sampled. The disclosed migration cost (pre-fix in-flight markers classify FOREIGN once, converging through full gates) is the safe direction. (2) G2 derive de-swallow: both no-stored-phase arms of DerivePhaseWithStatusWithCache now propagate a failed child read instead of deriving `plan` from a nil set, and the consistency checker returns the documented empty sentinel — a direct extension of the AC-4b/R1.4 fabrication-kill class into the pre-080 fallback my round-1 pass had accepted as-is; derive_swallow_test.go pins it. (3) G3/G4 render sweep: state.go, spec.go, approve/spec.go, complete.go lineage refusal, and beads.go's scopeResolutionRefusal all route bd-derived text through RenderBDError/bdRenderedError (Unwrap preserved, so the lock-failure timeout classification is intact), and select.go's guidance strings no longer interpolate the caller selector into executable-shaped spans — the selection CONTRACT (exact-first, suffix-aware, ambiguity-erroring, pick totality) is byte-for-byte preserved; the ambiguous-match message now lists real idrender-gated candidate IDs, an improvement. The net-new recovery-line quoting in renderBDError (any bd stderr line reading as an ADR-0035 `recovery:` line is strconv.Quote'd) degrades only forgeable paste-authority, not the AC-11 content contract — schema-error lines still surface verbatim. (4) G5 approve tail: the old 'Commit approval artifacts before continuing' instruction described work ApproveSpec had already performed; the new 'Approval artifacts committed' line is truthful against approve/spec.go's auto-commit + clean-tree verification, with a real-executor e2e (spec_commit_e2e_test.go) — an R2-honesty gain. (5) G7 docs: phaselock.go's writer inventory and lifecycle-modes.md's citations are function-name-anchored (line numbers had drifted), the completeSyncPhase residual is now DISCLOSED in the guide's writer-taxonomy section per the recorded option-2 disposition, and ADR-0041's amendment gained the attestation description. Empirical re-verification at tip 0783a507: rebuilt the binary; `state show` from the spec worktree still returns honest review+activeSpec, and the bd-unreachable probe still exits non-zero with the ADR-0035 refusal + `recovery: mindspec doctor` (now RenderBDError-escaped). Suites: full-tree `go test ./... -short -count=1` GREEN at 0783a507 (my own run, zero non-ok lines); internal/validate/readiness passes in 45s standalone. This also retires my round-1 INFO caveat: the two round-1 background runs eventually surfaced FAILs that were pure timeout kills (readiness at the 600s default; cmd/mindspec at exactly my 30m cap, dying in an os/exec wait) under ~27 concurrent panel go-test processes AND a mid-run tree advance to the round-2 tip — both packages pass on the quieter machine at the fixed tip. My independent no-short cmd/mindspec re-run at 0783a507 was still executing at verdict time; the fixer's tip report (no-short PASS, -race ×5, -short 48/48) plus my green -short tree stand as the evidence, and I will flag immediately if my run lands red.

findings.title: G1 attestation couples marker publication to bd metadata writes — assessed acceptable, no new availability class
findings.detail: Materialization marker publication now requires a successful bd MergeMetadata before any ref publish (refuse-before-publish on failure). complete already requires bd for the close and step-6.5 sync, so no new availability dependency is introduced; the plan's 'materialization stays uncoupled from the phase lock' instrument choice is preserved (the attestation is a bd key write, not the flock, and not a mindspec_phase write, so the writer-inventory fence is correctly unaffected). Recorded so the tally sees the coupling was judged, not missed.
